FROM servicenow-incidents-*
| WHERE priority IN (1, 2) AND ci.name IS NOT NULL AND opened_at >= NOW() - 31 days
| STATS cis = VALUES(ci.name)
| EVAL ci = MV_APPEND("(no CI selected)", cis)
| MV_EXPAND ci
| EVAL ord = CASE(ci == "(no CI selected)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, ci ASC
| KEEP ci

| EVAL ord = CASE(incident == "(all incidents)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, incident DESC
| KEEP incident
